items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: And T-Boy, I can't think of T-Boy's last name, but I know they did call him T-Boy. He was the bass player.

ctx.x: Well, Sam, he was playing trumpet. And his clarinet player was Joe Watson. Then Alfred William used to play with him. Oh, yeah. The drummer. And T-Boy, I can't think of T-Boy's last name, but I know they did call him T-Boy. He was the bass player.
Bass, yeah. Well, I never knew him except T-Boy Ramay. You know, the trumpet player used to be in the
United States. Yeah, no, this is another T-Boy. And Yank used to play trombone with him.
